flavor: "My armor won't like it, but I'm gonna go all out!"
name: Alloy
text: Toughness. [star] Interrupt: When Alloy makes a basic attack, remove a tough status card from her → she gets +5 ATK for that attack.

flavor: "I come from the 30th century."
name: Iron Lad
text: Action: Exhaust Iron Lad and deal 1 damage to him → search the encounter deck for a treachery card and discard it. (Shuffle.) If that card has a boost ability, ready Iron Lad.

name: Iron Man
text: While you control at least 6 [[Armor]] or [[Tech]] upgrades, Iron Man gets +1 THW and +1 ATK. Response: After Iron Man enters play, ready an Armored upgrade you control.

flavor: "It's now or never."
name: Iron Man MK I
text: Toughness. Action: Spend X [energy] resources → Iron Man MK I gets +X THW and +X ATK until the end of the round.

name: Iron Patriot
text: While you control at least 6 [[Armor]] or [[Tech]] upgrades, Iron Patriot gains "Interrupt: When a treachery card is revealed, exhaust Iron Patriot and spend an [energy] resource → cancel the effects of that card."

flavor: "I'm still just your friendly neighborhood Spider-Man!"
name: Iron Spider
text: [star] Interrupt: When Iron Spider attacks or thwarts, resolve that attack or thwart against up to three different enemies or schemes instead.

flavor: "Don't take another step towards me!"
name: Ironheart
text: Action: Exhaust Ironheart and deal 1 damage to her → each other friendly character gets +1 THW until the end of the round.

flavor: "How do I feel, Tony? Invincible."
name: Rescue
text: Interrupt: When a friendly character would take damage from an attack, exhaust Rescue and deal 1 damage to her → prevent up to 2 damage from that attack.

flavor: "It smells like a new car in here!"
name: Spider-Man
text: Response: After Spider-Man enters play, choose an Armored upgrade in your discard pile and add it to your hand.

name: War Machine
text: War Machine enters play with a number of missile counters equal to the number of [[Armor]] or [[Tech]] upgrades you control (to a maximum of 6). Action (attack): Exhaust War Machine and remove X missile counters from here → deal X damage to each enemy.

flavor: "Hope this doesn't void the warranty…" —Iron Man
name: Built to Last
text: Hero Action: Choose to either remove 1 armor counter from an Armored upgrade you control, or discard an Armored upgrade you control → give your identity a tough status card.

flavor: "Gatling guns? No problem." —War Machine
name: Bulletproof Plating
text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When you would take any amount of damage from the villain's attack, exhaust a [chassis] upgrade you control to prevent an amount of damage equal the number of armor counters on that upgrade.

flavor: "Just another routine training exercise." —James Rhodes
name: Carry the Load
text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove 2 threat from a scheme. You may exhaust a [boots] upgrade you control to remove an additional 2 threat from that scheme.

flavor: "A stunt this big… it's once in a lifetime." —Iron Man
name: EMP Blast
text: Requirement ([energy] [mental] [physical]). Hero Action: Remove 4 threat from each scheme. You may choose to either stun an enemy or discard a [[Tech]] attachment from play.

flavor: "You'll have to get through me first." —Iron Man
name: Energy Shield
text: Hero Interrupt (defense): When a friendly character would take any amount of damage, remove 1 charge counter from a [reactor] upgrade you control → prevent 4 of that damage.

flavor: "You really ought to be more careful." —Iron Man
name: Fly Safe
text: Play only if your identity has the [[Aerial]] trait. Hero Action (thwart): Remove 3 threat from a scheme. Give a friendly character a tough status card.

name: Gather Intel
text: Hero Action (thwart): Look at the top card of the encounter deck. If the number of icons in that card's boost area is at least: • 0 – remove 1 threat from a scheme. • 1 – remove 2 threat from a scheme. • 2 – draw 1 card.

name: Laser Sweep
text: Hero Action (attack): Remove 1 charge counter from a [reactor] upgrade you control → choose a player and deal 2 damage to each minion engaged with that player. You may exhaust a [gauntlets] upgrade you control to repeat this ability without paying its cost.

name: Lightbend Protocol
text: Hero Action (thwart): Remove up to 3 threat from among schemes in play (5 threat instead if the villain is confused). Hero Action: Remove 1 charge counter from a [reactor] upgrade you control → confuse an enemy.

name: Make It Your Own
text: Hero Action: Exhaust an Armored upgrade you control → search your deck for a hero-specific card with a printed resource cost equal to the amount of charge counters on the exhausted card and add it to your hand.

name: Optimal Advantage
text: Play only if your identity has the [[Avenger]] trait. Hero Action: Place a total of X status cards on up to X characters (to a maximum of 3 characters), where X is equal to the villain's stage number.

flavor: "Entering the warzone, weapons hot." —War Machine
name: Rain Fire
text: Hero Action (attack): Exhaust an upgrade you control with the [[Tech]] and [[Weapon]] traits → deal 3 damage to up to 3 enemies.

flavor: "We're almost back at full power, boss." —P.E.P.P.E.R.
name: Recharge
text: Action: Place 1 charge counter on an Armored upgrade you control (2 charge counters instead if it is a [reactor] upgrade).

name: Redistribution Spell
text: Play only if your identity has the [[Mystic]] trait. Max 1 per deck. Hero Action: Give your identity a tough status card. Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. For each Armored card that was discarded this way, stun an enemy.

flavor: "They say the best weapon is the one you never have to fire. I respectfully disagree. I prefer the weapon you only have to fire once." —Tony Stark
name: Repulsor Blast
text: Hero Action (attack): Remove 1 charge counter from a [reactor] upgrade you control → deal 4 damage to an enemy.

flavor: "Synchronise repulsors on my mark." —Rescue
name: Repulsor Bombardment
text: Alliance. (The players can pay this card's costs as a group.) Hero Action (attack): Deal 3[per_hero] damage divided among enemies as you choose.

name: Rocket Punch
text: Hero Action (attack): Deal 3 damage to an enemy. You may exhaust a [gauntlets] upgrade you control to deal 3 additional damage. You may exhaust a [boots] upgrade you control to give this attack overkill.

flavor: "Sometimes you have to run before you can walk." —Tony Stark
name: Stabilize
text: Play only if your identity has the [[Aerial]] trait. Hero Response: After your hero uses a basic power, ready your hero.

flavor: "Y'know that's really hard on your knees. Totally impractical, they all do it." —Deadpool
name: Superhero Landing
text: Hero Response: After you change form, seek an Armored upgrade from your deck and put it into play.

flavor: "Pull up sensors. What are we dealing with?" —Iron Man
name: Tactical Analysis
text: Hero Action: Draw 1 card. Remove X charge counters from a [reactor] upgrade you control → look at X cards from the top of the encounter deck.

name: The Progenitor
text: Action: Shuffle this card into the encounter deck (without looking). When Revealed: Search your deck and discard pile for an upgrade with cost 2 or less. Put that upgrade into play and remove this card from the game. This effect cannot be cancelled.

flavor: "That'll buff right out." —Tony Stark
name: Tinkering
text: Alter-Ego Action: Exhaust your alter-ego → search your deck, discard pile, and play area for a [chassis] upgrade, then play that card reducing its resource cost by 1.

name: Unibeam
text: Hero Action (attack): Remove 2 charge counters from a [reactor] upgrade you control → deal 4 damage to an enemy. Deal 1 additional damage to that enemy for each [[Armor]] or [[Tech]] upgrade you control (to a maximum of 12 damage). This attack gains overkill.

flavor: "F.R.I.D.A.Y., get me Yellowjacket's last known location. I can't find my helmet, seems there's been another tech theft." —Iron Man
name: "We Are Iron Man"
text: Max 2 per deck. Max 1 per round. Action: Choose a player. That player discards an upgrade they control → reduce the cost of each upgrade played this round by 1.

flavor: RATATATATAT!
name: Autocannon
text: Hero Response: After you remove any number of charge counters from an Armored upgrade you control, deal 1 damage to an enemy.

name: Rescue Chassis
text: Ablative (5 armor counters). Your hero gets +1 DEF. Hero Response: After you defend against an attack initiated against another player, the attacker gets -1 SCH and -1 ATK for their next activation.

name: Rescue Gauntlets
text: Hero Interrupt: When you defend against an attack initiated against another player, you get +1 DEF for that attack. If you take no damage from that attack, reduce the resource cost of the next event played this phase by 1.

flavor: "Civilians are in danger. I'm en route!" —Rescue
name: Rescue Helmet
text: Hero Response: After you defend against an attack and take no damage, remove 1 threat from the main scheme.

name: Smart Missiles
text: Uses (2 missile counters). Hero Action: Exhaust Smart Missiles and remove 1 missile counter from here → deal 3 damage divided among enemies as you choose.

name: Smashtronaut Chassis
text: Play only if your identity has at least 14 printed hit points. Ablative (4 armor counters). Hero Action: Remove an armor counter from here → until the end of the round, your hero gets +1 ATK for every 2 charge counters on a [reactor] upgrade you control. (Max 1 per round.)

name: Stealth Suit Gauntlets
text: Capacity (2 charge counters). Hero Response (attack): After you look at the top card of the encounter deck, remove 1 charge counter from here → for each icon in that card's boost area, deal 1 damage to an enemy.

name: Stealth Suit Helmet
text: Capacity (2 charge counters). You ignore the patrol keyword. Hero Response: After you thwart, remove 1 charge counter from here → look at the top 2 cards of the encounter deck.

name: Taser Module
text: Max 1 per player. Hero Interrupt: When a boost ability would be resolved during an enemy attack, discard this card → cancel that boost ability and stun that enemy.

flavor: "Jam all signals!" —Iron Man
name: Techno-Espionage
text: Max 1 per player. Response: After you look at any number of cards from the encounter deck, discard this card → confuse an enemy.

name: The Engine Room
text: Include in your deck only if your identity has at least 14 printed hit points. Permanent. Setup. Hero Action: Take 2 damage → place an armor counter on a [chassis] upgrade you control. (Limit once per round.)

flavor: "I just wanted to fly." —Ironheart
name: Thruster Boots
text: Hero Response: After you remove a charge counter from an Armored upgrade you control, exhaust Thruster Boots → your hero gains the [[Aerial]] trait until the end of the round.

name: Upper-Altitude Boots
text: Capacity (3 charge counters). Hero Interrupt: When you use a basic power, if you have the [[Aerial]] trait, remove 1 charge counter from here → you get +1 to that power for this use.

name: Virtual Interference
text: Max 1 per player. Suppress. (Treat the text box of the attached card as blank.) Hero Action: Attach to a non-permanent side scheme without the victory keyword. This card gains temporary.

name: War Machine Chassis
text: Ablative (4 armor counters). You gain an additional [accessory] slot which can only be used for [[Weapon]] upgrades. Hero Action: Exhaust this card → search the top 4 cards of your deck for a [[Weapon]] upgrade and add it your hand.

flavor: "You have a big gun, I AM the big gun." —War Machine
name: War Machine Gauntlets
text: Hero Resource: Generate a [physical] resource for an [[Attack]] event. (Limit once per round, limit twice per round instead if you control at least 6 [[Tech]] or [[Weapon]] upgrades.)

name: War Machine Helmet
text: Capacity (2 charge counters). Hero Response: After you play an [[Attack]] event, exhaust War Machine Helmet and remove 1 charge counter from here → play that event from your discard pile (paying its costs).
